Name: Elead, Son of Shuthelah
Summary: Son of Shuthelah, slain by the men of Gath born in the land.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:21: Son of Shuthelah, slain by the men of Gath born in the land.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Elead stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
